حمٓ
Ha, Meem
Ha, Meem
Ḥā Mīm. The discussion on similar letters has already passed in Sūrah Al-Baqarah.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ حم
وَٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡمُبِينِ
By the clear Book
By the Manifest Book
Allah takes an oath on the Qur’ān which clearly explains the path of guidance towards the truth.
وَالْكِتَابِ الْمُبِينِ
إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةࣲ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind]
We sent it down on a blessed night, and We have been warning [mankind]
Indeed, I revealed the Qur’ān on the Night of Decree; it is a night of much goodness. Indeed, I warn through this Qur’ān.
إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُبَارَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنْذِرِينَ
فِيهَا يُفۡرَقُ كُلُّ أَمۡرٍ حَكِيمٍ
On that night is made distinct every precise matter
Every definitive matter is resolved on it
On this night every precise matter related to provisions, lifespans etc. are decided which Allah is to make happen that year.
فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
أَمۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡ عِندِنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِينَ
[Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
as an ordinance from Us. We have been sending [apostles]
I decide every precise matter of Mine; indeed, I am the one who sends the messengers.
أَمْرًا مِنْ عِنْدِنَا ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing
as a mercy from your Lord—indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing—

O Messenger! I send the messengers through My mercy for those whom they are sent towards. Indeed, may I be glorified I am the Hearer of the statements of My servants, the Knower of their intentions; none of them are hidden from Me.
رَحْمَةً مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَآۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain
the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, should you have conviction
He is the Lord of the heavens, the earth and whatever lies between them. If you are convinced of that, then bring faith upon my Messenger.
رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُوقِنِينَ
لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ رَبُّكُمۡ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
There is no god except Him: He gives life and brings death, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers
There is no true deity except him. He gives life and causes death; there is no one that does that except Him. He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers before you.
لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ يَلۡعَبُونَ
But they are in doubt, amusing themselves
But they play around in doubt
These idolaters are not convinced of that, rather, they are in doubt about it and distract themselves from it with the falsehood they are in.
بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانࣲ مُّبِينࣲ
Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
So watch out for the day when the sky brings on a manifest smoke
So O Messenger! Wait for their punishment that will come soon: a day when the sky is clearly filled with smoke.
فَارْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي السَّمَاءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُبِينٍ
يَغۡشَى ٱلنَّاسَۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ
Covering the people; this is a painful torment
enveloping the people. [They will cry out:] ‘This is a painful punishment
It will cover the people, and will be said to them, “This punishment that has afflicted you is a painful punishment.”
يَغْشَى النَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
رَّبَّنَا ٱكۡشِفۡ عَنَّا ٱلۡعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤۡمِنُونَ
[They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers
Our Lord! Remove this punishment from us. Indeed we have believed!’
They will then beg their Lord, asking him, “O our Lord! Turn the punishment that you sent upon us, away from us. If you turn it away from us, we will believe in You and in Your Messenger.”
رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ وَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ مُّبِينࣱ
How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger
What will the admonition avail them, when a manifest apostle had already come to them
How can they take heed and repent to their Lord now, when a clear Messenger came to them before, and they knew of his truthfulness and honesty?
أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ الذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُبِينٌ
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمࣱ مَّجۡنُونٌ
Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman
but they turned away from him, and said, ‘A tutored madman?’
They turned away from believing in him, and said about him, “He was taught. Other people taught him; he is not a messenger.” They also said, “He is a madman.”
ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا مُعَلَّمٌ مَجْنُونٌ
إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابِ قَلِيلًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ عَآئِدُونَ
Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief]
Indeed We will withdraw the punishment a little; but you will revert [to your earlier ways]
Indeed, when I turn the punishment away from them for a short while, they will return to their disbelief and rejection.
إِنَّا كَاشِفُو الْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَائِدُونَ
يَوۡمَ نَبۡطِشُ ٱلۡبَطۡشَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution
The day We shall strike with the most terrible striking, We will indeed take vengeance [on them]

O Messenger! Wait for the day when I will seize the disbelievers with the greatest seizing, by entering them into the hellfire on the Day of Judgement wherein they will live forever. I will take retribution from them for their disbelief in Allah and rejecting His messengers.
يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ الْبَطْشَةَ الْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنْتَقِمُونَ
۞وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَجَآءَهُمۡ رَسُولࣱ كَرِيمٌ
And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger
Certainly We tried the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble apostle came to them
And verily I tested the people of Pharaoh before them, and their noble messenger came to them from Allah calling them towards His oneness and worship. He was Moses (peace be upon him).
۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَاءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
أَنۡ أَدُّوٓاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ رَسُولٌ أَمِينࣱ
[Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger
[saying,] ‘Give over the servants of Allah to me; indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you

Moses said to Pharaoh and his people, “Leave the Israelites to me, because they are the servants of Allah; you have no right to take them as slaves. Indeed, I am a messenger to you from Allah, I am trustworthy in conveying what He has commanded me to convey. I will not take anything away from it nor add anything to it.”
أَنْ أَدُّوا إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنࣲ مُّبِينࣲ
And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority
Do not defy Allah. Indeed I bring you a manifest authority
“And do not show arrogance to Allah by leaving His worship and assuming superiority over His servants. Indeed, I will bring to you a clear proof.”
وَأَنْ لَا تَعْلُوا عَلَى اللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّي آتِيكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُبِينٍ
وَإِنِّي عُذۡتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمۡ أَن تَرۡجُمُونِ
And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me
I seek the protection of my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me
“And I have sought protection in my Lord and your Lord from you killing me by stoning.”
وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَنْ تَرْجُمُونِ
وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone
And if you do not believe me, keep out of my way.’
“If you do not believe in whatever I have brought, then leave me alone; do not approach me intending harm.”
وَإِنْ لَمْ تُؤْمِنُوا لِي فَاعْتَزِلُونِ
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوۡمࣱ مُّجۡرِمُونَ
And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people
Then he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘These are indeed a guilty lot.’
Then Moses supplicated to his Lord: “This nation i.e. Pharaoh and his people, are a criminal nation who deserve a swift punishment.”
فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ قَوْمٌ مُجْرِمُونَ
فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
[Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued
[Allah told him,] ‘Set out by night with My servants; for you will be pursued
So Allah commanded Moses to take his people away at night, and informed him that Pharaoh and his people will pursue them.
فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلًا إِنَّكُمْ مُتَّبَعُونَ
وَٱتۡرُكِ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ رَهۡوًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّغۡرَقُونَ
And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned
Leave behind the sea unmoving; for they will be a drowned host.’
He also commanded him that when they all cross the sea, to leave it standing as it was, because Pharaoh and his people were to be destroyed by drowning in it.
وَاتْرُكِ الْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُنْدٌ مُغْرَقُونَ
كَمۡ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ
How much they left behind of gardens and springs
How many gardens and springs did they leave behind
How many gardens and flowing springs did Pharaoh and his people leave behind!
كَمْ تَرَكُوا مِنْ جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
وَزُرُوعࣲ وَمَقَامࣲ كَرِيمࣲ
And crops and noble sites
Fields and splendid places
And how many farms and beautiful places did they leave behind!
وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
وَنَعۡمَةࣲ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
And comfort wherein they were amused
and the affluence wherein they rejoiced
And how many lives of luxuries they used to live, did they leave behind!
وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَۖ وَأَوۡرَثۡنَٰهَا قَوۡمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people
So it was; and We bequeathed them to another people
Whatever has been described to you happened to them, and we made another nation i.e. the Israelites inherit their gardens, springs, farms and structures.
كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْمًا آخَرِينَ
فَمَا بَكَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved
So neither the sky wept for them, nor the earth; nor were they granted any respite
Neither the heavens nor the earth cried over Pharaoh and his people when they drowned, nor were they given respite to repent.
فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّمَاءُ وَالْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا مُنْظَرِينَ
وَلَقَدۡ نَجَّيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡمُهِينِ
And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
Certainly We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
And verily I saved the Israelites from the humiliating punishment, because Pharaoh and his people would kill their children and keep their women alive.
وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الْمُهِينِ
مِن فِرۡعَوۡنَۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُسۡرِفِينَ
From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors
of Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a tyrant among the transgressors
I saved them from the punishment of Pharaoh. Indeed, he was an arrogant one from those who transgressed the command and religion of Allah.
مِنْ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِنَ الْمُسْرِفِينَ
وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds
Certainly We chose them knowingly above all the nations
And verily I selected the Israelites knowingly over the people of their time, because of their many Prophets.
وَلَقَدِ اخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ
وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤࣱ اْ مُّبِينٌ
And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial
and We gave them some signs in which there was a manifest test
And I granted them miracles through which I gave strength to Moses, and in which there was an obvious blessing for them, like the Mann and Salwā and other than them.
وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَاءٌ مُبِينٌ
إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying
These ones say
Indeed, these rejecting idolaters will say, denying the resurrection:
إِنَّ هَٰؤُلَاءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوۡتَتُنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected
‘It will be only our first death, and we shall not be resurrected
“It is only our first death that we will die; there is no life after that, and we are not going to be resurrected after this death.”
إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا الْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنْشَرِينَ
فَأۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful
Bring our fathers back [to life], if you are truthful.’
“O Muhammad! If you are truthful in your claim that Allah will resurrect the dead alive for requital and accountability, then bring back to life our forefathers who have died.”
فَأْتُوا بِآبَائِنَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
أَهُمۡ خَيۡرٌ أَمۡ قَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ مُجۡرِمِينَ
Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals
Are they better, or the people of Tubba‘, and those who were before them? We destroyed them; indeed, they were guilty
O Messenger! Are these denying idolaters stronger and more resistant, or the people of Tubba‘ and those after them like the ‘Ād and Thamūd? I destroyed them all. Indeed, they were criminals.
أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَالَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مُجْرِمِينَ
وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play
We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them for play
And I did not create the heavens, the earth and everything between it in jest and amusement.
وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَاعِبِينَ
مَا خَلَقۡنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know
We did not create them except with consummate wisdom; but most of them do not know
I only created it due to a profound wisdom, but the majority of idolaters do not know that.
مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَا إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
إِنَّ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all
Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst for them all
The day of judgment in which Allah will decide between the servants is the appointed time for all of the creation in which Allah will gather them.
إِنَّ يَوْمَ الْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلࣰ ى شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped
the day when a friend will not avail a friend in any way, nor will they be helped

The day when no relative will benefit his relative or friend benefit his friend nor will they be saved from Allah’s punishment, because authority on that day will be for Allah. Nobody will be able to claim it.
يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَنْ مَوْلًى شَيْئًا وَلَا هُمْ يُنْصَرُونَ
إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
except for him on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-merciful
Except the person Allah has mercy on, for he will benefit from the good action he has sent forward. Allah is the Mighty whom nobody can overpower, Wise in His creation, decree and plan.
إِلَّا مَنْ رَحِمَ اللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ هُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الرَّحِيمُ
إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
Indeed the tree of Zaqqum
The tree of zaqqum which Allah has grown at the bottom of the fire
إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ الزَّقُّومِ
طَعَامُ ٱلۡأَثِيمِ
Is food for the sinful
will be the food of the sinful
Is the food of the extremely sinful who will eat of its horrible fruit!
طَعَامُ الْأَثِيمِ
كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
Like molten copper it will boil in their bellies
Like black oil, boiling in their stomachs due to its intense heat.
كَالْمُهْلِ يَغْلِي فِي الْبُطُونِ
كَغَلۡيِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
Like the boiling of scalding water
seething like boiling water
Like the boiling of extremely hot water.
كَغَلْيِ الْحَمِيمِ
خُذُوهُ فَٱعۡتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
[It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire
[The keepers of hell will be told,] ‘Seize him and drag him to the middle of hell
It will be said to the keepers of hell: “Grab him, drag him violently and harshly towards the middle of the fire”.
خُذُوهُ فَاعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الْجَحِيمِ
ثُمَّ صُبُّواْ فَوۡقَ رَأۡسِهِۦ مِنۡ عَذَابِ ٱلۡحَمِيمِ
Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water
then pour over his head boiling water as punishment
Then pour hot water over the head of this person being punished, so that the punishment does not separate from him.
ثُمَّ صُبُّوا فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْحَمِيمِ
ذُقۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡكَرِيمُ
[It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble
[and tell them,] “Taste this! Indeed you are the [self-styled] mighty and noble
It will be said to him, mockingly: “Taste this painful punishment. You are the mighty who is not treated unjustly, noble amongst your people.
ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْكَرِيمُ
إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمۡتَرُونَ
Indeed, this is what you used to dispute
This is what you used to doubt!’
This is the punishment you used to doubt will occur on the Day of Judgment, but now your doubt has been removed from you by seeing it”.
إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَمْتَرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينࣲ
Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place
Indeed the Godwary will be in a safe place
Those who are mindful of their Lord through carrying out His commands and refraining from His prohibitions will be in a place of residence, safe from every misfortune that could afflict them.
إِنَّ الْمُتَّقِينَ فِي مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
فِي جَنَّٰتࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ
Within gardens and springs
amid gardens and springs
In gardens and flowing springs.
فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
يَلۡبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسࣲ وَإِسۡتَبۡرَقࣲ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other
dressed in fine silk and brocade, sitting face to face
They will wear in Paradise fine and thick silk. They will be facing one another and not see each other’s nape.
يَلْبَسُونَ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُتَقَابِلِينَ
كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينࣲ
Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes
So shall it be, and We shall wed them to black-eyed houris
Just as I will honour with that which is mentioned, I will marry them in Paradise to beautiful women with beautiful wide eyes.
كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُمْ بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure
Secure [from any kind of harm,] there they will call for every kind of fruit [they wish]
They will call their attendants therein to bring them every fruit they wish, safe from their being cut off and from their harms.
يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ آمِنِينَ
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
Other than the first death, they will not taste death therein, and He will save them from the punishment of hell
Living therein forever. They will not taste death therein except the first death in the worldly life, and their Lord will save them from the punishment of the fire.
لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا الْمَوْتَةَ الْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
فَضۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment
—a grace from your Lord. That is the great success

As a grace and kindness from your Lord to them, O Messenger. That which is mentioned, namely entering them into Paradise and saving them from the fire is the great success which no success can compare with.
فَضْلًا مِنْ رَبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرۡنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded
Indeed We have made it simple in your language, so that they may take admonition
I have made this Qur’ān easy and facilitated it for you by revealing it in your language of Arabic, O Messenger, so that they take heed.
فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَاهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end]
So wait! They [too] are waiting
So await your help and their destruction; they are awaiting your destruction.
فَارْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُمْ مُرْتَقِبُونَ
